searchText: Hi all, sharing here a write-up by myself, <@544848504078598144> and <@600991921275535360> presenting a few ideas about how to improve the consensus (esp. fork-choice) spec compliance framework. https://docs.google.com/document/d/1HMSxMNY3nZR4NKohIQAhzRTzYnKEJEU9ro8Z8kcnH2c/ It would be great to discuss some of the ideas presented there at the next CL call. <@415109946682769408> we don't support light client spectests in prysm AFAIK, but anyway I was surprised to see this directory structure, are you sure this is alright? ``` tests/minimal/bellatrix/light_client/sync/pyspec_tests/capella_deneb_fork/steps.yaml ``` I think it is a on purpose "multi fork" test case that starts with bellatrix state, forks to capella, and then forks to deneb. /cc'ing <@881905303011086387> the test case author to double confirm. yes, the first folder is the one that indicates where to start on. The ones in the back (in the test name) indicate possible followup forks that are being advanced to as part of the test. See `tests/formats/light_client/sync.md` for explanations on what forks to use when loading individual `steps.yaml`
